The '''1898–99 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by ten points over nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. Rangers won all 18 of their league matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scottishfootballmuseum.org.uk/the-season-of-1898-99/|title=The Season of 1898-99|author=Stuart Spencer|date=16 January 2019|publisher=[[Scottish Football Museum]]|access-date=24 March 2020|archive-date=18 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418184414/https://scottishfootballmuseum.org.uk/the-season-of-1898-99/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>[https://rangers.co.uk/club/history/rangers-history/the-beginning-of-glory/ The beginning of glory] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201229202410/https://www.rangers.co.uk/ |date=2020-12-29 }}, Rangers FC</ref><ref>[https://www.theglasgowstory.com/image/?inum=TGSA00544 Rangers Team, 1898-99 (Mitchell Library, Glasgow Collection)], The Glasgow Story</ref><ref>[https://www.glasgowtimes.co.uk/news/18995617.amp/ The first great Rangers team whose 'perfect season' remains unique in British football 122 years on], Matthew Lindsay, Glasgow Times, 7 January 2021</ref>
